content: {"reasoning":"The primary payer denied the service as a plan exclusion, not for authorization, coding, or missing information, so resubmission and authorization-based rework are improper and a medical-necessity appeal is unlikely to overturn the benefit exclusion. Because COB order is correct and an active secondary plan exists, the primary denial should now be submitted to the secondary; this action also has the strongest similar-claim result at 1/1 paid.","action":"bill_secondary"}
